other_capital_items.required_treatment: Model forward settlement and ATM financing as separate paired cash-and-share scenarios. Do not treat authorization or borrowed hedge shares as cash received or newly issued company shares. Include pending acquisition cash, debt, acquired operations and issuance consistently in a separate transaction scenario if analyzed.

final_model_rules: Working full-conversion/full-vesting/full-exercise denominator is 655.006167 million before forward/ATM/merger scenarios; preserve approximation and dates.
Credit gross option proceeds once when using full exercise; do not also use treasury-stock net dilution. Track already received proceeds separately to prevent duplication in cash.
If modeled equity value makes exercise uneconomic, test an unexercised option branch; do not mechanically assume the historical market price equals intrinsic value.
Compare note-converted and note-retained cases; do not deduct note principal or net book value in the converted case.
Preferred economic participation is included once; do not also subtract the same preferred claim as a separate equity-bridge deduction.
All-RSU-vesting is an assumption. Distinguish existing awards from future compensation and avoid ignoring future SBC economics.
Unissued equity-plan capacity is not an outstanding award. Do not add the entire authorized reserve.
No capped-call value is credited in this preliminary bridge; qualify and test this conservative omission before final recommendation.
Do not label the scenario fully diluted in an exhaustive sense: forwards, future financing and pending acquisition are shown separately.
